content.text: Digital creators in regions like Nigeria and Venezuela face significant barriers when trying to sell products online. Platforms like [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/stripe-alternatives-nigerian-creators-honest-side-side-breakdown-17|Stripe Alternatives]] and PayPal are often unavailable, leaving creators in the lurch. However, there's a powerful solution that leverages GitHub Pages for free hosting of a digital product store, allowing creators to maintain control while avoiding exorbitant platform fees. This guide breaks down the architecture behind this system, demonstrating how to set up a fully operational store without relying on conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-first-principles-definitive-5|payment]] processors.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/understanding-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-plain-language-15. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

Using GitHub Pages as a hosting solution for digital product stores offers a cost-effective and reliable alternative for creators locked out of traditional payment gateways. This architecture ensures that creators retain ownership of their data and products, eliminating the need for third-party platforms that often impose high fees. For instance, while Gumroad takes 10% of each sale, working with [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/nowpayments-integration-static-site-crypto-payments-explained-digital-16|COREMERCH guide to nowpayments]] only incurs a 0.5% fee, translating to substantial savings. As a creator, you can keep more of your revenue and invest it back into your craft.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The underlying architecture is simple yet powerful. GitHub Pages serves as the hosting platform, allowing creators to deploy static websites rapidly and at no cost. Coupled with Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, backend logic can be seamlessly integrated to manage orders and deliveries. NOWPayments handles crypto payments efficiently, providing instant transaction verification without the need for a centralized payment processor. This architecture not only supports multiple cryptocurrencies but also ensures that creators have full autonomy over their digital products.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This system is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where conventional payment solutions are inaccessible. Whether you're selling ebooks, courses, or templates, this architecture empowers you to operate independently. By deploying your store on GitHub Pages, you sidestep the restrictions imposed by platforms like PayPal and Gumroad. This approach is particularly beneficial for creators focused on retaining their revenue and establishing a direct connection with their audience, free from the constraints of high fees and reliance on third-party services.
GitHub Pages enables free hosting without platform restrictions.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Key components of this architecture include GitHub Pages for hosting, NOWPayments for payment processing, and Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend functionality. GitHub Pages provides a reliable platform to showcase and sell your products without a hosting fee. NOWPayments allows you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, ensuring a flexible payment option for your customers. Finally, using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers enables automated delivery of digital products, streamlining the entire process from purchase to fulfillment.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, first set up a GitHub Pages account and create a new repository for your digital store. Next, configure your site using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to showcase your products. Then, integrate Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to handle backend order processing and automate product delivery. Finally, set up NOWPayments to facilitate crypto transactions. By following these steps, you can launch a digital product store that operates independently and efficiently. For a comprehensive guide, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all necessary blueprints and templates.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, consider using GitHub Pages combined with NOWPayments for crypto transactions. This setup allows you to maintain full ownership of your products while minimizing costs. By leveraging free hosting and low transaction fees, you can effectively market and distribute your digital downloads.
NOWPayments offers a fraction of the fees compared to traditional platforms.

The Complete Builder Kit ($197) offers all the tools you need to build and deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack. By visiting https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, you can access everything necessary to get started.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Create a GitHub account and set up a new repository for your digital products. 2. Build your website using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to present your offerings. 3. Implement Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to automate order processing. 4. Register with NOWPayments to accept cryptocurrency payments. 5. Test the entire process to ensure smooth operation before launching your store.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I host my digital store for free?

You can host your digital store for free using GitHub Pages. Simply create a repository, upload your website files, and enable GitHub Pages in the repository settings to make your store accessible online.
What payment options can I offer without traditional platforms?

Using NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, providing your customers with diverse payment options. This method circumvents traditional payment processors, allowing you to operate independently.
How can I automate product delivery?

Automate product delivery by using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. These tools can trigger instant delivery of digital products upon successful payment confirmation, streamlining the customer experience.
What are the cost savings compared to platforms like Gumroad?

Gumroad charges a 10% fee on each sale, while NOWPayments only charges 0.5%. On 100 sales at $97 each, the fee difference results in $921 retained by the creator, highlighting significant cost savings.
Is there a limit to the number of products I can sell?

There is no inherent limit to the number of products you can sell using GitHub Pages. Your repository can be organized to accommodate as many products as you need, provided you manage your site effectively.
Full ownership of your digital products means no ongoing subscription fees.
